text: Shannon Christoffersen, Manager, Data and Information Services, ORCID:0000-0002-4895-7747 Arctic Institute of North America, University of Calgary Are You an NCP Researcher? To make the NCP Publications Database as complete as possible, NCPfunded researchers can help by reporting their publications to astis@ucalgary.ca.

The Northern Contaminants Program requests all NCP Researchers obtain an Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID). ORCIDs provide a way to uniquely identify researchers' records in Canadian polar databases and will allow easy cross-linking of records between the NCP’s website and the NCP Publications Database. They are also increasingly being required for publication submission. To obtain your own ORCID identifier, please register at http://orcid.org and send your 16 digit identifier to arctic@ucalgary.ca.

The NCP Publications Database is an initiative to make publications resulting from Northern Contaminants Program projects easily In operation since 2003, the NCP Publications Database project aims to:

• Support awareness of contaminants in the North from long-range sources and the work that is underway to address the issue by making NCP publications discoverable and accessible in the NCP Publications Database, the Arctic Science and Technology Information System (ASTIS), and the Canadian Consortium for Arctic Data Interoperability (CCADI) system.
• Help support the food choice decisions among consumers of traditional/country foods by making NCP publications on this topic accessible in the database.

• Build capacity in the North to participate in and/or contribute to addressing these issues by ensuring that community members can easily discover and access information on this subject in the database, including, as needed, providing webinars and training workshops on database use.

As of 30 November 2022, 4,628 publications resulting from research and communication funded by the Northern Contaminants Program, have been added to the NCP Publications Database. This includes 1,452 papers in the Synopsis of Research volumes, 1,262 journal papers, and 1,914 other publications.
Publications available on the Web are hyperlinked: 2,455 records have URLs that take you directly to the PDF files of the publications.

1,117 of the 1,262 journal papers have DOIs (digital object identifiers) or URLs, which are hyperlinked. Clicking on the link will take you to the publisher's website and, if your organization has a subscription, to a PDF file of the paper.
